name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V5.2
release_notes: Interactive tug-force simulator: center-lead tugs orbit the securing point by clock order and apply towing force and turning moment to the target vessel.
Side pusher tugs approach stand-off hull stations without crossing the vessel and apply directional pushing forces.
Target vessel now responds with translation, rotation, inertia and damping instead of visual-only tug movement.
Dynamic Command Center unit selection from the 15-vessel fleet, up to four displayed units.
Selected unit cards drive camera, telemetry and operator controls; fixed DR BOAT 1/2 cards removed.
Added per-unit Push-to-Talk operator control placeholder for future vessel audio hardware integration.
JAWAD 1 conventional profile hides azimuth thruster gauges and keeps twin engine / hydraulic rudder controls.
JAWAD 1 360-degree LiDAR plan view upgraded to animated top-view boat, quay and rotating scan beam.
Responsive scrollable pages, zoom/pan training map, six tug stations, Tug & Barge target, and desktop launcher auto-versioning retained.
